invariants.Source raw note: The workflow LLM node failed because Cognitive Memory context had no project scope.
invariants.Expected behavior: Workflow JSON projectId is passed to MAF context contributors as project scope.
invariants.Disallowed shallow implementation: Do not disable Cognitive Memory and do not catch all contributor failures.
invariants.Failing-first test: Original log demonstrated missing project scope; no separate pre-patch test was retained.
invariants.Production assertions: CreateExecutionOptions resolves projectId and CreateCapabilityStateCoreAsync receives the explicit context scope.
invariants.Downstream dependency check: SB02 live Office365 workflow completed after this invariant was implemented.

invariants.Source raw note: A newly created project can have no Cognitive Memory context yet.
invariants.Expected behavior: Empty context pack is reported as a skipped contribution with trace metadata.
invariants.Disallowed shallow implementation: Do not treat actual recall exceptions as skipped.
invariants.Failing-first test: Live run before this fix failed after Graph fetch with empty context pack.
invariants.Production assertions: Only blank rendered context is skipped; InvalidOperationException still uses SkipOrFail.
invariants.Downstream dependency check: SB02 live run produced the markdown asset instead of stopping at Cognitive Memory.
